summary: Russia launched a massive multi-axis drone and missile strike across at least ten Ukrainian regions on 26 October 2026, employing Geran-5, reactive Shaheds, Kh-59 and Banderoil cruise missiles against Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Chernivtsi, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia and others. Ukrainian air defenses engaged widely; hits were confirmed on the Epicentr hypermarket and Metro store in Vinnytsia, Kyiv's Desnyanskyi and Darnytskyi districts, and a cruise missile over Dnipro. Simultaneously, Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka and Vovdvizhivka in Donetsk region, while explosions damaged a Belgorod shopping mall and a major railway derailment in the Urals disrupted Russian military logistics.
key_points: Massive multi-axis drone attack: 5 Geran-5 from Chernihiv to Kyiv, 2 reactive Shaheds from Odesa to Vinnytsia, 1 from Kherson to Zaporizhzhia, 1 from Bryansk to Chernihiv, 1 from Rivne to Volyn. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77548)
Kyiv's Desnyanskyi district hit by 5 Geran-5; Darnytskyi district also targeted; air raid alert active 13:46-13:49. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77550, @eRadarrua/126406)
Vinnytsia Epicentr hypermarket and Metro store struck by at least 4 Geran-5; reconnaissance drone observed prior. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77564, @mon1tor_ua/77565, @mon1tor_ua/77566)
Kh-59 cruise missiles fired at Kropyvnytskyi; Banderoil-type cruise missile detected over Dnipro. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77557, @mon1tor_ua/77568)
Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka and Vovdvizhivka in Donetsk region per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23932)
Belgorod MegaGrinn mall heavily damaged by apparent Ukrainian drone strike; Urals railway derailment burned 7 fuel tanks, disrupting military logistics. (Source: @eRadarrua/126427, @eRadarrua/126379)
Starlink access restricted for Ukrainian offensive drone strikes per SpaceX; Black Sea shipping attacks exceed 570 vessels in 2026. (Source: @UkraineNow/84898, @UkraineNow/84899)
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launch from Bryansk region reported by monitoring channels. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77556)
